author: Akihiro-Tabuchi
title: GPU unit tests fail to extract OpenVINO package - tbb12.dll locked (Access denied) on Windows self-hosted runner
signature: remove item cannot remove item access to the path is denied unauthorizedaccessexception|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Expand-Archive cannot remove tbb12.dll, Access denied

key_errors:
Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll:
Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
+ FullyQualifiedErrorId : RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive -Force on the self-hosted Windows GPU runner ('ov-dmz-35'). PowerShell's -Force tries to delete the pre-existing tbb12.dll before overwriting it, but the DLL is still locked (loaded/held open) by a leftover process from a prior job on the same persistent runner, so Remove-Item throws UnauthorizedAccessException and the step exits with code 1. This is the fourth occurrence of this exact signature in under two hours across multiple unrelated PRs/runs, confirming it is a recurring runner-state issue rather than anything introduced by this PR's changes.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible outside CI: requires the specific self-hosted Windows GPU runner state (a lingering handle on install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/tbb12.dll from a previous job). Locally, the equivalent failure can be forced by holding tbb12.dll open (e.g. load it in another process) and then running Expand-Archive -Force over the same destination.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'GPU unit tests' job; the lock is transient and typically clears once the previous process releases the handle.

Have the runner cleanup/finalize step for 'GPU unit tests' jobs explicitly stop/kill any process holding a handle on install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin/*.dll before the next job starts (e.g. via Restart-Service or process enumeration with handle.exe).

Consider replacing Expand-Archive -Force with a pre-step that deletes the previous install directory recursively (with retry/backoff) before extracting, instead of relying on Expand-Archive's in-place overwrite semantics.
Approve the already-proposed rerun-pattern PR (#39664) so the workflow rerunner can auto-retry this specific transient failure going forward.
prevention_strategies: Add a runner-level safeguard that ensures no previously-started OpenVINO process (test binaries, plugins) keeps the install directory's DLLs open past job completion, e.g. a post-job cleanup hook that forcibly closes handles or restarts the runner's working directory between merge-queue runs on the same Windows GPU host.
historical_context: Same signature (hash 95bb23aa2ed8a84d) seen 3 times before in roughly the preceding 2 hours: runs 42662261631 (19:06 UTC), 42668697675 (19:42 UTC), and 42680170472 (20:50 UTC), affecting PR #39444 and this same PR #39034. A rerun-pattern proposal for this signature is already open as PR #39664 (not yet merged).
